claim/defer_backoff_ms.label: Defer backoff (ms)
claim/defer_backoff_ms.description: How long a job that lost the per-conversation claim waits before it is offered again.

stream/poll_interval_ms.label: Stream poll interval (ms)
stream/poll_interval_ms.description: How often an open stream looks for new events.

stream/heartbeat_seconds.label: Stream heartbeat (s)
stream/heartbeat_seconds.description: Idle interval after which the stream sends a comment frame so a proxy does not close it.

stream/max_duration_seconds.label: Maximum stream duration (s)
stream/max_duration_seconds.description: A stream is closed after this long; the client reconnects with its cursor.

stream/max_deltas_per_execution.label: Maximum deltas per execution
stream/max_deltas_per_execution.description: Deltas past this count are dropped and the stream reports a gap.

stream/max_fragment_bytes.label: Maximum bytes per streamed field (text, tool input, tool output)

sweep/pending_grace_seconds.label: Pending submission grace (s)
sweep/pending_grace_seconds.description: How old a `pending` message must be before the sweep finishes it - long enough that a submission still in flight is never raced.

retention/event_days.label: Event retention (days)
retention/event_days.description: A conversation_event older than this is pruned. Clock: created_at.

retention/outbox_days.label: Outbox retention (days)
retention/outbox_days.description: A relayed outbox row older than this is pruned. Clock: created_at.

retention/archived_days.label: Archived conversation retention (days)
retention/archived_days.description: An archived conversation is deleted this long after it was last updated. Clock: conversation.updated_at.

retention/idle_days.label: Idle conversation retention (days)
retention/idle_days.description: A conversation whose newest message is older than this is archived (not deleted; the archived window then decides the delete). Clock: that message's created_at, or the conversation's own when it has no messages.
